_key.description: The two variant keys, each followed by its allele pair, together with the ancestry group. SHA-256 hashed when that string is 254 characters or longer.

_from.description: Document handle of the source node, in collection/key form.

_to.description: Document handle of the target node, in collection/key form.

chr.description: Chromosome the pair of variants lies on.

negated.description: Sign of the Pearson correlation between the two reference alleles, as written by the adapter: true when TopLD reports +, false when it reports -.

variant_1_base_pair.description: Reference and alternate alleles of the first variant.

variant_2_base_pair.description: Reference and alternate alleles of the second variant.

variant_1_rsid.description: dbSNP identifier of the first variant.

variant_2_rsid.description: dbSNP identifier of the second variant.

r2.description: Squared Pearson correlation of the two variants on phased haplotypes, from TOPMed ancestry-specific LD.

d_prime.description: Lewontin's D' between the two variants, from TOPMed ancestry-specific LD.

ancestry.description: Ancestry group the LD estimate was computed in.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction.

source.description: The dataset or consortium this record was loaded from.

source_url.description: Link to the specific upstream record or file this data was loaded from.

accessible_via.return: chr, ancestry, d_prime, label, r2, variant_1_base_pair, variant_1_rsid, variant_2_base_pair, variant_2_rsid, source, source_url
